svg.title: Premise / הקדמה
svg.desc: Chapter 7, Hebrew p93, English p94. A solid teal statement unit starts a downward outgoing inference arrow aimed toward a dotted horizontal boundary beneath it. The dots represent the further reasoning into which this premise feeds. The filled unit is the statement taken as the starting point of this deduction; the badge does not certify independent truth. This is a logical role, not a new Chapter 9 move or a causal event.
